passiveEffects.name: Gale Wings
passiveEffects.originalDescription: While at high HP, movement speed is increased. While at 85% max HP or above, this Pokémon's movement speed is increased by 15%.
passiveEffects.summary: While at high HP, movement speed is increased. While at 85% max HP or above, this Pokémon's movement speed is increased by 15%.

normalAttackEffects.name: Attack
normalAttackEffects.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind around the user and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied until used. Basic and boosted attacks lunge at the target opposing Pokémon.

moveEffects.originalDescription: Fly toward an enemy and attack 3 times. The user dashes at the designated opposing Pokémon then pecks three times, damaging opposing Pokémon hit.

moveEffects.name: Acrobatics
moveEffects.originalDescription: Fly toward the designated area and attack multiple times. Escape in a direction of your choice after using this move. The user dashes toward the designated location then attacks the area around them three times, damaging nearby opposing Pokémon. The user can choose to dash in the direction of movement afterward.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Flame Sweep
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: Perform an aerial somersault before charging forawrd, dealing damage to enemies in this move's path and shoving them. The user performs an aerial somersault and sweeps forward, becoming unstoppable, receiving 50% reduced damage, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and shoving them toward the end of the sweep, then damaging opposing Pokémon again. This Unite Move cannot go through walls. Unite buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
